name: axis-pro
description: Professional-grade, minimalist desktop video editor with recording, multi-track editing, text overlays, and AI-powered shorts generation

scripts.dev: npm run build:main && concurrently "vite" "wait-on http://localhost:5173 && electron dist/main/main/main.js"
scripts.build: npm run build:main && npm run build:renderer
scripts.build:main: tsc -p tsconfig.main.json && tsc -p tsconfig.preload.json && echo '{"type":"module"}' > dist/main/package.json
scripts.build:mac: npm run build && npm run pack:mac
scripts.build:win: npm run build && npm run pack:win

author: Yahav Corcos
